summary: Full text of the Boswellin Super trial (105 knee-OA adults, 300 or 600 mg/day, 90 days) shows primary WOMAC total better than placebo at days 60 and 90 (p<0.0001); it is maker-sponsored and gets the record's one eligible context. The 2020 meta-analysis pools mostly combination products and active comparators, so it gets no credit; the Aflapin trial is abstract-only. The existing applicability source list is narrowed to 39092235; its outcome and form constraints stay.

applicability.studied_population: Adults with newly diagnosed mild-to-moderate degenerative knee OA given Boswellin Super 300 or 600 mg/day for 90 days (PMID 39092235); named standardized-extract evidence does not establish equivalence to every generic resin extract.

population.description: 105 newly diagnosed adults with degenerative hypertrophic knee OA (Kellgren-Lawrence below grade III) randomized 35:35:35 at two Indian sites; 98 completed and were analysed.

study_contexts.study_design: Double-blind, randomized, three-arm, parallel-group, two-centre placebo-controlled trial (CTRI/2022/11/047397), 90 days; completers analysis with two-way ANOVA and Tukey post hoc comparisons.

dose.administration_frequency: One 150 mg or 300 mg tablet twice daily after breakfast and dinner.
dose.reported_regimen: [300, 600] mg/day; 90 days; 150 or 300 mgtablet twice daily after breakfast and dinner

normalization.basis: Reported study-material daily dose, not a universal threshold or equivalence to other preparation.

source_provenance.location: Full text (PMC11291344): Methods (test material standardization, design, sample size, dosing, endpoints, statistics), Results Tables 2-3 between-group ANOVA and WOMAC paragraph, Conflict of interest.

co_therapies: Celecoxib 200 mg/day permitted as rescue medication.

outcomes.name: Primary: modified WOMAC total and VAS change to days 30/60/90. WOMAC total differed from placebo at days 60 and 90 for both doses (p<0.0001); day-90 WOMAC total placebo 31.3, BSE-150 12.1, BSE-300 10.4. VAS separated from placebo by day 60-90 (e.g., day 90 female and male subsets p<=0.008).
Secondary WOMAC subscales, Lequesne, EQ-5D and 6-minute walk improved; hs-CRP fell with BSE-300 (between-group p=0.018); day-5 changes are within-group onset findings only.

limitations: Day-5 'onset' claims are within-group changes, not the primary comparative endpoint; small regional industry trial analysed in completers.
Funded/conducted with Sami-Sabinsa: five authors employed by Sami-Sabinsa Group or Sabinsa Corporation, the Boswellin Super maker.
Boswellin Super is standardized to >=30% AKBBA with 50-55% total beta-boswellic acids; results do not establish equivalence for unstandardized resin extracts or other branded extracts.
Returned A128 'source-content hold' is resolved for this trial by full-text verification within knee-OA pain, stiffness and function.
Context authored and source-verified by agent review (Claude) on 2026-10-28; Dr. Pham's pre-approval of fully source-verified contexts attested by Sean on 2026-10-28.

identity.preparation: Seven trials: Aflapin or 5-Loxin alone (3 trials) and Boswellia combinations with curcuminoids, Elaeagnus or MSM (4 trials).

population.description: 7 RCTs, 545 patients with knee osteoarthritis in India, Armenia, Iran and Italy; mean ages about 52-63.

study_contexts.study_design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of RCTs of Boswellia or its extract versus placebo or western medicine; primary outcomes VAS, WOMAC pain, stiffness, function and Lequesne index.

dose.administration_frequency: Trial-specific daily regimens for 4-12 weeks (study characteristics tables).
dose.reported_regimen: Aflapin 100 mg, 5-Loxin 100 or 250 mg, boswellic acid 150 mg + curcuminoids 350 mg, Boswellia + Elaeagnus, boswellic acid 7.5-15 mg + MSM 5,000-10,000 mg (study characteristics table).
co_therapies: Comparators were placebo in 5 trials, ibuprofen (Karimifar 2017) and glucosamine sulfate 3,000 mg (Notarnicola 2016).

source_provenance.location: Full text (PMC7368679): Methods, Results (study characteristics tables, risk of bias), pooled outcome tables, references 26/24/33-37.

outcomes.name: VAS WMD -8.33 (95% CI -11.19 to -5.46); WOMAC pain -14.22 (-22.34 to -6.09); stiffness -10.04 (-15.86 to -4.22); function -10.75 (-15.06 to -6.43); Lequesne -2.27 (-3.08 to -1.45); very high heterogeneity in time-point analyses.

limitations: No credit: four of seven pooled trials tested Boswellia combined with curcuminoids, Elaeagnus or high-dose MSM, and two used active comparators, so the pooled effect cannot be attributed to Boswellia alone.
Statisticians were unblinded in the three Aflapin/5-Loxin trials (rated high risk of bias).
Context authored and source-verified by agent review (Claude) on 2026-10-28; Dr. Pham's pre-approval of fully source-verified contexts attested by Sean on 2026-10-28.

clinical_review.notes: No credit transferred: full text not open access, so methods, primary endpoint and between-group statistics could not be verified.

source_provenance.location: PubMed abstract (J Am Nutr Assoc 2023; not open access).

limitations: Abstract: 70 knee-OA subjects randomized to Aflapin 100 mg or placebo for 30 days; 67 completed; VAS, LFI and WOMAC fell 41-66% in the Aflapin group. Reported as within-group percentages; between-group results not verifiable from the abstract. Not a finding that the source is invalid.
Context authored and source-verified by agent review (Claude) on 2026-10-28; Dr. Pham's pre-approval of fully source-verified contexts attested by Sean on 2026-10-28.
